title: Poultry Farming Management System
summary: Agricultural technology system digitizing poultry farm operations, livestock tracking, and production logging.
problem: Traditional poultry farm record-keeping leads to inaccurate egg production counts, feed waste, and missed health checks.
solution: Designed an integrated farm management system tracking flock batches, feed consumption, mortality rates, and sales.
features: Flock health and daily egg production logging module
Feed inventory management and re-order threshold alerts
Farm sales and revenue reporting dashboard
